notes: Die cut sticker in the shape of the bubble, navy with a white i, no die line in the source. The cut-contour group is the bubble outline traced from the source path. Sheet TerminalStickers_September2026.pdf (271 x 391 mm, no bleed, no trim marks): a hairline die line (black, 0.25 to 0.74 pt) around each white sticker. The template replaces that line by a ThruCut contour 0.2 mm inside the trim and adds a 3 mm bleed. Source blue CMYK 99.5/85/21.4/6.8 (drift, see tokens.json observed): the template uses the token blue.
